name: DMCPA
summary: DMCPA, also known as 2,5-dimethoxy-4-methylphenylcyclopropylamine, is a psychedelic drug of the phenethylamine, amphetamine, and phenylcyclopropylamine families related to DOM. It is a derivative of tranylcypromine and is the cyclized phenethylamine analogue of DOM in which the α and β positions have been connected with a carbon atom to form a cyclopropyl group.

pharmacology.text: The comprehensive receptor interactions of DMCPA have been studied. In contrast to tranylcypromine, it shows very weak activity as a monoamine oxidase inhibitor (MAOI).
pharmacology.kind: Serotonin 5-HT2A receptor agonist; Serotonin receptor modulator; Serotonergic psychedelic; Hallucinogen

uses.en: It is a research compound used to study how psychedelics fit the serotonin 5-HT2A receptor. It has no medical use and is rarely seen outside the laboratory.
uses.zh: 它是研究用化合物，用來探討迷幻藥如何與血清素5-HT2A受體結合。它沒有醫療用途，在實驗室之外很少見。
uses.zhHans: 它是研究用化合物，用来探讨迷幻药如何与血清素5-HT2A受体结合。它没有医疗用途，在实验室之外很少见。

sideEffects.en: Little is known about it in people. Psychedelics related to DOM can cause nausea, a raised heart rate and blood pressure, anxiety and confusion.
sideEffects.zh: 目前對它在人體的影響所知甚少。與DOM相關的迷幻藥可能造成噁心、心跳與血壓上升、焦慮與意識混亂。
sideEffects.zhHans: 目前对它在人体的影响所知甚少。与DOM相关的迷幻药可能造成恶心、心跳与血压上升、焦虑与意识混乱。

fact.en: Its cyclopropane ring locks the side chain into a fixed shape. Comparing its forms helped chemists work out which shape of such drugs fits the serotonin 5-HT2A receptor best.
fact.zh: 它的環丙烷環把側鏈固定成特定形狀。藉由比較它的不同異構形式，化學家得以推斷這類藥物以何種形狀最能契合血清素5-HT2A受體。
fact.zhHans: 它的环丙烷环把侧链固定成特定形状。借由比较它的不同异构形式，化学家得以推断这类药物以何种形状最能契合血清素5-HT2A受体。
